from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalance(BaseModel):
    """A cash balance record extracted from a financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the statement belongs to")
    reporting_fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year covered by this report (e.g., 2022, 2023)")
    balance_date: str | None = Field(description="The specific date of the balance (e.g., December 31, 2022)")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is a beginning or ending balance for the stated year")
    item_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item name (e.g., 'Cash and Cash Equivalents')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of currency (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalance]
